    Guidelines for Developers

    In order to contribute to PowerSimulations.jl repository please read the following sections of InfrastructureSystems.jl documentation in detail:

    1. Style Guide
    2. Contributing Guidelines

    Pull requests are always welcome to fix bugs or add additional modeling capabilities.

    All the code contributions need to include tests with a minimum coverage of 70%
